references.text: Ezekiel uses the same language about wasting away in one's sins and the iniquities of the fathers
Describes how the people will waste away in their iniquities
The continuation of the verse that mentions the iniquities of the fathers which they confess
God visits the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, the same theme of inherited guilt
Jeremiah laments that the sins of the fathers strike the children; they will die in enemy land
The Lamentations confess that the fathers sinned and the children bear the consequences
Nehemiah describes confession of one's own sins and the iniquities of the fathers
Daniel confesses the sins of the fathers as the cause of the exile
